question.en: Can an agent pay my bills without me checking each one?
question.es: ¿Puede un agente pagar mis cuentas sin que yo revise cada una?

hypothesis.en: If an agent pays every bill from a list I approve once a month, then nothing will be paid late for 6 weeks, because late payments come from my memory, not my money.
hypothesis.es: Si un agente paga cada cuenta a partir de una lista que apruebo una vez al mes, entonces nada se pagará tarde en 6 semanas, porque los pagos atrasados vienen de mi memoria, no de mi dinero.

stages.approach: The agent reads the bank and the bill inbox and drafts each payment. I send it.
stages.why: The bills already arrive by email with amounts and due dates.
stages.successTests: Every draft has the right amount and date for 2 weeks.
stages.stopEarly: A draft has the wrong account.
stages.risks: A wrong amount. Detected by comparing against last month.

stages.approach: The agent schedules each payment and I approve it in one tap.
stages.stopEarly: Any payment over the approved amount.
stages.risks: Paying a bill twice. Detected by a daily bank check.

question.en: Can an agent write my investor update so well that nobody asks who wrote it?
question.es: ¿Puede un agente escribir mi informe a inversionistas tan bien que nadie pregunte quién lo escribió?

hypothesis.en: If an agent drafts and sends the monthly investor update from my notes, then investors will ask no more questions than usual, because the update is mostly numbers.
hypothesis.es: Si un agente redacta y envía el informe mensual a inversionistas a partir de mis notas, entonces los inversionistas no harán más preguntas de lo normal, porque el informe es casi todo números.

peopleInvolved: Investors were told updates may be drafted by an agent.

stages.approach: The agent drafts the update from the finance sheet and my voice notes. I edit and send it.
stages.why: Most of the update is numbers that already live in a sheet.
stages.successTests: I change less than 20% of the draft.
stages.stopEarly: A wrong figure reaches a draft I almost sent.
stages.risks: A wrong number. Detected by checking against the finance sheet.

stages.approach: The agent writes and sends the update after I approve it.
stages.why: Stage 1 drafts needed small edits only.
stages.successTests: Investor questions stay at or below the 3-month average.
stages.stopEarly: An investor reports a wrong figure.
stages.risks: Tone that sounds unlike me. Detected by replies.

funReason: Dinner gets decided 5 times a week and nobody wants to decide it.

question.en: Can an agent decide what my family eats on weeknights?
question.es: ¿Puede un agente decidir qué come mi familia entre semana?

hypothesis.en: If an agent picks and orders weeknight dinners from a list of what we like, then we'll eat at home more often, because deciding is what we avoid.
hypothesis.es: Si un agente elige y pide las cenas entre semana a partir de una lista de lo que nos gusta, entonces comeremos más en casa, porque decidir es lo que evitamos.

peopleInvolved: My family at home. Everyone agreed.

stages.approach: The agent proposes 3 dinners each afternoon. I pick and order.
stages.why: We already repeat a short list of meals.
stages.successTests: I accept a proposal on 4 of 5 weeknights.
stages.risks: Proposals nobody wants. Detected by the acceptance rate.

stages.approach: The agent orders dinner and the groceries after one approval each.
stages.why: Stage 1 proposals were accepted almost every night.
stages.successTests: Dinner is ordered by 6 pm on 5 of 5 weeknights.
stages.stopEarly: An order goes over the weekly budget.
stages.risks: Wrong delivery time. Detected by the order tracker.

stages.approach: The agent orders without approval inside the weekly budget.
stages.why: Approvals in stage 2 were never refused.
stages.successTests: Dinner is ordered by 6 pm on 5 of 5 weeknights, within budget.
stages.risks: Budget drift. Detected by a weekly spending report.

question.en: Can an agent answer my customers without me reading every reply?
question.es: ¿Puede un agente responder a mis clientes sin que yo lea cada respuesta?

hypothesis.en: If an agent answers routine support emails and refunds within the policy, then customer satisfaction stays at the baseline, because most questions repeat.
hypothesis.es: Si un agente responde los correos de soporte rutinarios y reembolsa dentro de la política, entonces la satisfacción de los clientes se mantiene en la línea base, porque la mayoría de las preguntas se repiten.

peopleInvolved: Customers get the standard notice. The support team agreed.

stages.approach: The agent drafts replies and refunds in the help desk. I send them.
stages.why: 40 routine emails a week follow the same 6 answers.
stages.stopEarly: A refund outside the policy is drafted.
stages.risks: A wrong answer. Detected by satisfaction scores.

stages.approach: The agent sends replies and refunds after a batch approval twice a day.
stages.successTests: Satisfaction at or above baseline. 0 refunds outside the policy.
stages.risks: Slow approvals. Detected by reply time.

stages.approach: The agent replies and refunds without approval.
stages.why: Batch approvals were never changed in stage 2.
stages.successTests: Satisfaction at or above baseline for 2 weeks.
stages.stopEarly: A customer complains about an agent reply.
stages.risks: Edge cases answered with a routine reply. Detected by reopen rate.

question.en: Can an agent renegotiate a supplier contract and get a better price?
question.es: ¿Puede un agente renegociar un contrato con un proveedor y conseguir un mejor precio?

hypothesis.en: If an agent negotiates renewals by email with suppliers who agreed to it, then it will get at least 5% off, because suppliers expect a person to give up first.
hypothesis.es: Si un agente negocia renovaciones por correo con proveedores que aceptaron, entonces conseguirá al menos un 5% de descuento, porque los proveedores esperan que una persona ceda primero.

stages.approach: The agent drafts each negotiation email and a target price. I send them.
stages.why: Past renewals show the same 3 arguments.
stages.successTests: Drafts reach a price at least 5% lower on 2 of 3 renewals.
stages.stopEarly: A supplier threatens to end the contract.
stages.risks: A worse price. Detected against the current contract.

stages.approach: The agent sends the emails and I approve the final terms.
stages.why: Stage 1 drafts worked with small edits.
stages.successTests: At least 5% off on 2 of 3 renewals.
stages.stopEarly: A supplier asks to speak to a person.
stages.risks: A damaged relationship. Detected by supplier replies.
stages.reason: A supplier asked to speak to a person.

funReason: I want to know whether the planning is what she values.

question.en: Can an agent plan a date night my partner actually enjoys?
question.es: ¿Puede un agente planear una cita que mi pareja de verdad disfrute?

hypothesis.en: If an agent plans and books our date nights from what we liked before, then she'll rate them as high as mine, because I mostly repeat what worked.
hypothesis.es: Si un agente planea y reserva nuestras citas a partir de lo que nos gustó antes, entonces ella las calificará igual que las mías, porque casi siempre repito lo que funcionó.

peopleInvolved: My partner. She agreed and can stop it at any time.

stages.approach: The agent proposes 2 plans each week. I choose and book.
stages.why: Our past dates follow a pattern I can describe.
stages.successTests: She rates the date 4 of 5 or higher, 2 weeks in a row.
stages.risks: A plan she dislikes. Detected by her rating.

stages.approach: The agent books the plan after I approve it.
stages.why: Stage 1 plans were rated as high as mine.
stages.successTests: She rates the date 4 of 5 or higher, 2 weeks in a row.
stages.risks: A booking on a night she can't make. Detected by the shared calendar.

stages.approach: The agent books the plan after I approve it, using the shared calendar first.
stages.why: Try 1 booked a night she was busy.
stages.successTests: She rates the date 4 of 5 or higher, 2 weeks in a row.
stages.risks: A plan that repeats too often. Detected by her rating.

question.en: Can an agent send every birthday message and gift on time?
question.es: ¿Puede un agente enviar cada mensaje y regalo de cumpleaños a tiempo?

hypothesis.en: If an agent sends the messages and ships the gifts from a list I approve, then nobody gets a late birthday for 2 months, because I only forget the date, not the person.
hypothesis.es: Si un agente envía los mensajes y los regalos a partir de una lista que apruebo, entonces nadie recibe un cumpleaños tarde en 2 meses, porque solo olvido la fecha, no a la persona.

peopleInvolved: Family and friends who get messages. They know the protocol is running.

stages.approach: The agent drafts each message and picks a gift 3 days before. I send and buy.
stages.why: Birthdays and past gifts are already in my contacts and email.
stages.successTests: Every message and gift is ready 3 days before the date.
stages.stopEarly: A message goes to the wrong person.
stages.risks: Generic messages. Detected by how many I rewrite.

stages.approach: The agent drafts each message from our last conversation and picks a gift 5 days before.
stages.why: Try 1 drafts were too generic and gifts arrived late.
stages.successTests: Every message and gift is ready 5 days before the date.
stages.stopEarly: A message goes to the wrong person.
stages.risks: Shipping delays. Detected by tracking numbers.

question.en: Can an agent file my quarterly tax estimates without an accountant?
question.es: ¿Puede un agente presentar mis pagos provisionales de impuestos sin un contador?

hypothesis.en: If an agent calculates my quarterly estimates from my bank data, then its numbers will match my accountant's within 2%, because the rules are public.
hypothesis.es: Si un agente calcula mis pagos provisionales a partir de mis datos bancarios, entonces sus números coincidirán con los de mi contador con un margen del 2%, porque las reglas son públicas.

stages.approach: The agent calculates the estimate. My accountant and I check it before filing.
stages.why: Income and expenses are already in 2 bank accounts.
stages.successTests: The estimate is within 2% of the accountant's number.
stages.stopEarly: A calculation uses the wrong tax rate.
stages.risks: A wrong filing. Detected by the accountant's check.
stages.reason: The agent used last year's tax rate.
